purpose: Low-context index for continuing governed benchmark AI review without rereading PROJECT_STATE.md and HANDOVER.md on every batch.

contract.approvalRule: Only import ai-evidence-verified after two independent AI reviewer approvals through the benchmark review importer.
contract.publicationRule: Candidate courses remain hidden until every benchmark in the course is verified and the explicit launch registry/publication gate is applied.

oracle.note: Published through the explicit launch registry on 2026-08-31 after full AI-evidence verification and evidence-link verification.

snowflake.note: Snowflake is fully AI-evidence verified at 150/150 after optimized labelled compact batches 1a-1k. Static triage is 0 and benchmark validation passes. Existing user-visible status remains from earlier release path; this checkpoint now supports treating the full Snowflake benchmark pack as AI-evidence verified, not human/vendor reviewed.

aws.note: Fully AI-evidence verified on 2026-08-31 through optimized labelled compact packets batch5a-batch5g with independent chat-level primary/critic consensus and guarded dry-run imports. Still not user-visible until explicit launch registry publication and production smoke verification.

databricks.note: Published through the explicit launch registry on 2026-08-31 after full AI-evidence verification and evidence-link verification.

power-bi.note: Power BI batches 1a through 1e completed through two-model chat-level AI consensus. Batch 1e used gpt-5.4-mini as primary and gpt-5.5 as critic after compact-packet remediation. Static triage is 0 and benchmark validation passes.

reviewerModelStrategy.rule: Use compact labelled packets, static triage before reviewer calls, primary first, and spend critic only after primary approval. Do not import single-model approvals.

latestMilestone.summary: AWS, Databricks, Informatica, Oracle, and Snowflake are fully AI-evidence verified at 150/150 each. Power BI is 100/150 ai-evidence-verified after batches 1a through 1e. Remaining draft courses are Power BI 50 and Python 150. Static triage is 0 and benchmark validation passes.
latestMilestone.launchStatus: AWS and Power BI are not launched; Snowflake is fully AI-evidence verified and already user-visible from earlier release path. Do not describe any course as human-reviewed or vendor-certified.

productionDeployment.smoke: Production /api/courses exposes Snowflake, Informatica, Databricks, and Oracle; Databricks and Oracle beginner samples return 10 questions; AWS remains blocked with HTTP 400.

rules: Do not print full JSONL packets unless debugging requires it.
Use ID/count summaries for routine state.
Use labelled compact packets so reviewers do not accidentally review stale aws.jsonl content.
Before any reviewer call, run validate:review-packet and proceed only when the packet has draft records, no duplicates, and no verified records.
Read PROJECT_STATE.md and HANDOVER.md only at start/end of larger checkpoints or when contract ambiguity exists.
Update PROJECT_STATE.md and HANDOVER.md after meaningful milestones or before handoff, not every small batch.
Use gpt-5.4-mini for low-cost primary review while available; after retirement use gpt-5.6-luna. Use gpt-5.5 as critic when available and not usage-limited, otherwise use gpt-5.6-terra.
Use 20-record batches, run the primary first, and send only primary-approved records to the critic.
